contract.title: AUTO-07 接通CoordRunner启动/恢复与step人工收件检查点并修复分类账本摘要同步
contract.accepted_scope: Software and unit/integration verification in qa-sandbox:20261029 of CoordRunner restore_from_checkpoint and step intake scanning, idempotent ledger persistence, TaskLinkUpdate arch_breakdown revision/digest synchronization, and FEAT-20261104-001/002 r4 ledger alignment. Live systemd user service activation on the host is excluded to avoid lock contention with the active interactive COORD session; all in-scope checks are executed in server_qa so unexecuted is empty when those checks pass.

dependency_conditions.required: 继承AUTO-06已验收的CoordRunner单实例锁、SQLite恢复源与WorkIntakeManager收件底座（保留AUTO-06 Done状态与历史证据）

contract.checkpoint: 开工前绑定；restore_from_checkpoint与step检查点接通scan_work_intake；FEAT-20261104-001/002 r4摘要对齐；独立沙箱与Codex QA审阅

steps: git -C project-control checkout -- tools/coord_runner/runner.py tools/coord_runner/work_intake.py tools/test_coord_runner.py tools/test_work_intake.py docs/work_intake/features/FEAT-20261104-001.yaml docs/work_intake/features/FEAT-20261104-002.yaml docs/work_intake/.intake_digests.json

commands.command: python3 -m tools.coord_runner --intake-scan && python3 -m unittest tools/test_work_intake.py tools/test_coord_runner.py tools/test_coord_recovery.py tools/test_coord_systemd_service.py -v
commands.expected: coord_runner --intake-scan返回0且errors为空（FEAT-20261104-001@r4与FEAT-20261104-002@r4账本摘要一致）；test_work_intake、test_coord_runner（含step/restore检查点自动收件、重复检查幂等、坏文件隔离、AST函数<=50行且<=4参门禁）、test_coord_recovery与test_coord_systemd_service（含P1-14连续空闲轮询零模型调用）全部100% OK

positive_cases: CoordRunner在restore_from_checkpoint与step检查点自动调用scan_work_intake，新增Markdown提交单被识别一次并生成分类YAML，重复step不重复建单或调用模型
TaskLinkUpdate支持关联arch_breakdown并自动递增revision同步更新.intake_digests.json；FEAT-20261104-001/002升级为revision 4后--intake-scan零错误通过
在途任务(in_flight_tasks)、恢复记录与单实例锁保持一致，收件扫描不绕过ApprovalGuard批准、技术前置或LeaseManager租约
negative_cases: 单份坏文件（格式损坏或同revision篡改）被隔离在intake.errors中，不阻断其他合法提交单收件，也不破坏在途任务恢复
空闲轮询或未获批准的收件项严禁触发任何大模型调用或未授权派单；严禁将代码测试通过伪造为宿主机后台systemd服务已启用运行
